meanings.usage: 指非比寻常的、令人好奇的

meanings.meaning: 独特的（形容与众不同的、罕见的事物） adj.. 奇怪的

meanings.usage: 指具有容纳或支撑能力

meanings.meaning: 运载（指运输或承载人员、货物） v.. 支撑

meanings.usage: 指交通工具上的乘坐者
描述无人居住或空旷的地方
正式或礼貌地请求某事
描述可能造成伤害或风险的事物
指航空旅行或飞行动作

meanings.meaning: a block of flats　公寓楼

meanings.usage: 表示不同意或不愿做某事

examples.en: Captain Fawcett has begun a new service.
examples.zh: 福西特机长开始了一项新服务。

examples.en: This wonderful plane can carry seven passengers.
examples.zh: 这架神奇的飞机能载七名乘客。

examples.en: It can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a ploughed field.
examples.zh: 它能在任何地方降落：雪上、水上，甚至在耕过的田地上。

examples.en: A doctor flew from Birmingham to a lonely village.
examples.zh: 一位医生从伯明翰飞到一个偏僻的村庄。

examples.en: On another occasion, he landed in a deserted car park.
examples.zh: 另一次，他降落在一个人迹罕至的停车场。

examples.en: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request.
examples.zh: 福西特机长刚刚拒绝了一个奇怪的请求。

examples.en: The man wanted to fly to Rockall.
examples.zh: 那个人想要飞往罗卡尔岛。

examples.en: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats.
examples.zh: 有一次他降落在了一栋公寓楼的屋顶上。

examples.en: Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous.
examples.zh: 福西特机长没有带他去，因为旅途太危险了。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作或状态，与现在有联系或对现在有影响。通常与 already, yet, just, recently, since, for 等时间状语连用。 描述过去的动作对现在造成的影响，或表示动作持续到现在。本课中 has bought, has begun, has just refused 都使用了现在完成时。

examples.en: Captain Fawcett has bought an unusual taxi.
examples.zh: 福西特机长买了一辆不寻常的出租车。

examples.en: He has just refused a strange request.
examples.zh: 他刚刚拒绝了一个奇怪的请求。

examples.en: Since then, Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.
examples.zh: 从那以后，福西特机长载送乘客到过许多不寻常的地方。

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Simple Past Tense)
grammar.definition: 一般过去时表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态，常与具体的时间状语连用，如 yesterday, last week, in 2020 等。 描述在过去某个特定时间发生的动作，不强调与现在的关系。本课中 flew, landed, wanted 都使用了过去式。

examples.en: Captain Fawcett's first passenger was a doctor who flew from Birmingham.
examples.zh: 福西特机长的第一位乘客是一位从伯明翰飞来的医生。

examples.en: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats.
examples.zh: 有一次他降落在了一栋公寓楼的屋顶上。

examples.en: The man wanted to fly to Rockall.
examples.zh: 那个人想要飞往罗卡尔岛。

grammar.title: too + 形容词 + to do (太...而不能)
grammar.structure: too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: too 后面接形容词，to do 表示结果，意为"太...以至于不能..."，表示由于程度过高而无法做某事。 表示程度过高导致不可能做某事，to 后面接动词原形。本课中 too dangerous 就是这种用法。

examples.en: The box is too heavy to carry.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了，搬不动。

examples.en: He is too young to understand.

patterns.pattern: Has + 主语 + 过去分词...? (现在完成时一般疑问句)

original.en: Has Captain Fawcett bought an unusual taxi?
original.zh: 福西特机长买了一辆不寻常的出租车吗？

imitations.en: Has she begun a new service?
imitations.zh: 她开始了一项新服务吗？

imitations.en: Has he flown to many unusual places?
imitations.zh: 他飞去过许多不寻常的地方吗？

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has/have + just + 过去分词 (刚刚...)

original.en: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request.
original.zh: 福西特机长刚刚拒绝了一个奇怪的请求。

imitations.en: I have just finished my homework.
He has just arrived at the airport.

patterns.pattern: too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形 (太...而不能)

original.en: The trip was too dangerous to take.
original.zh: 这趟旅行太危险了，不能去。

imitations.en: The problem is too difficult to solve.
imitations.zh: 这个问题太难了，解决不了。

imitations.en: The coffee is too hot to drink now.
imitations.zh: 咖啡太烫了，现在不能喝。

patterns.pattern: once + 主语 + 过去式 (有一次/曾经)

original.en: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats.
original.zh: 有一次他降落在了一栋公寓楼的屋顶上。

imitations.en: Once he lost his wallet on the train.
imitations.zh: 有一次他在火车上丢了钱包。

lines.en: Captain Ben Fawcett has bought an unusual taxi and has begun a new service.
lines.zh: 本。弗西特机长买了一辆不同寻常的出租汽车，并开始了一项新的业务。

lines.en: The 'taxi' is a small Swiss aeroplane called a 'Pilatus Porter '.
lines.zh: 这辆“出租汽车”是一架小型瑞士飞机，叫“皮勒特斯。

lines.en: This wonderful plane can carry seven passengers.
The most surprising thing about it, however, is that it can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a ploughed field.
lines.zh: 这架奇妙的飞机可以载7名乘客。然而，最令人惊奇的是它能够在任何地方降落：雪地上，水面上，甚至刚耕过的田里。

lines.en: Captain Fawcett's first passenger was a doctor who flew from Birmingham to a lonely village in the Welsh mountains.
lines.zh: 弗西特机长的第一名乘客是位医生，他从伯明翰飞往威尔士山区一个偏僻的村庄。

lines.en: Since then, Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.
lines.zh: 从那时开始，弗西特机长已经载送乘客到过许多不寻常的地方。

lines.en: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats and on another occasion , he landed in a deserted car park.
lines.zh: 一次，他把飞机降落在了一栋公寓楼的屋顶上；还有一次，降落在了一个废弃的停车场上。

lines.en: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request from a businessman.
lines.zh: 弗西特机长刚刚拒绝了一位商人的奇怪要求。

lines.en: The man wanted to fly to Rockall, a lonely island in the Atlantic Ocean, but Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous.
lines.zh: 这个人想要飞往大西洋上的一个孤岛--罗卡尔岛，弗西特机长之所以不送他去，是因为那段飞行太危险了。

questions.q: Does Captain Fawcett think any trip is too dangerous?
questions.zh: 弗西特机长认为任何行程都太危险吗？
questions.a: No, he doesn't. He has already flown passengers to many unusual places; he refused only this one because the trip to Rockall was too dangerous.
questions.aZh: 不。他已经载送乘客到过许多不寻常的地方，只是因为飞往罗卡尔岛的这趟飞行太危险，才拒绝了这一次。
questions.hint: 答案落在最后一句：Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous。

questions.q: Why is the word 'taxi' printed in quotation marks, and what does 'a most unusual taxi' mean?
questions.zh: 为什么 taxi 一词要加引号？“一辆最不寻常的出租汽车”该怎么理解？
questions.a: Because it is not a real taxi but a small Swiss aeroplane called a 'Pilatus Porter'. In 'a most unusual taxi', most means very, not the superlative.
questions.aZh: 因为它不是真正的汽车，而是一架叫“皮勒特斯·波特”号的瑞士小型飞机；“a most unusual taxi”里的 most 相当于 very。

questions.q: Which two unusual landing places does the text give as examples?
questions.zh: 课文举了他两次不寻常的降落，分别是哪里？
questions.a: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats, and on another occasion he landed in a deserted car park.
questions.aZh: 一次，他把飞机降落在了一栋公寓楼的楼顶上；还有一次，降落在了一个废弃的停车场上。
questions.hint: 见原句 Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats and on another occasion, he landed in a deserted car park。

questions.q: What is the difference between refuse and deny, and which word does the text use about the strange request?
questions.zh: refuse 与 deny 有何区别？课文中拒绝商人请求用的是哪个词？
questions.a: The text uses refuse: 'Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request'. When it means 'not to accept or not to give', refuse and deny can replace each other, but only deny means 'to say that something is not true'.
questions.aZh: 课文用的是 refuse。表示“拒绝接受、拒绝给予”时 refuse 与 deny 可互换；但只有 deny 有“否认”之义。
questions.hint: 见讲义语法：has just refused a strange request。

questions.q: Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places, yet he refused to fly to Rockall. Is he a coward?
questions.zh: 机长去过许多不寻常的地方，却唯独拒绝飞往罗卡尔岛。他是胆小吗？
questions.a: No. He is not afraid of unusual places — he has landed on snow, water, a ploughed field, a roof and a car park. He refused only because the trip was too dangerous, which shows that he is a responsible pilot who puts his passengers' safety first.
questions.aZh: 不是。他从不畏惧不寻常的地方；他拒绝只是因为那段飞行太危险，说明他是把乘客安全放在第一位的负责机长。
questions.hint: 结合 has flown passengers to many unusual places 与 because the trip was too dangerous。

translation:
本。
弗西特机长买了一辆不同寻常的出租汽车，并开始了一项新的业务。
这辆“出租汽车”是一架小型瑞士飞机，叫“皮勒特斯。
波特“号。
这架奇妙的飞机可以载7名乘客。
然而，最令人惊奇的是它能够在任何地方降落：雪地上，水面上，甚至刚耕过的田里。
弗西特机长的第一名乘客是位医生，他从伯明翰飞往威尔士山区一个偏僻的村庄。
从那时开始，弗西特机长已经载送乘客到过许多不寻常的地方。
一次，他把飞机降落在了一栋公寓楼的屋顶上；还有一次，降落在了一个废弃的停车场上。
弗西特机长刚刚拒绝了一位商人的奇怪要求。
这个人想要飞往大西洋上的一个孤岛--罗卡尔岛，弗西特机长之所以不送他去，是因为那段飞行太危险了。
title: Taxi!
subtitle: 出租汽车

lead.question: 弗西特机长的“出租车”竟是一架飞机，他为何拒绝送商人去罗卡尔岛？
lead.warmup: 出租车通常在街上跑，可本课里的“出租车”却长着翅膀。本·弗西特机长买了一架瑞士小型飞机“皮勒特斯·波特”号，办起空中出租业务：它能载七名乘客，还能在雪地、水面甚至刚耕过的田里降落。他把医生送进威尔士山区，也降过公寓楼顶和废弃停车场。可当一位商人要飞往大西洋孤岛罗卡尔时，他却说了“不”。
goals: 掌握 taxi、land、plough、lonely、roof、block、flat、desert、refuse 等本课核心词的词义与搭配
理解过去分词 ploughed、deserted 作定语的位置规律及其与定语从句的转换
辨清一般过去时与现在完成时的时间状语差异，能在 since then、once、on another occasion 等语境中正确选时
区分 refuse 与 deny、bring/take/fetch、too 与 very，并掌握 a most + 形容词 表“非常”
lead.summary: 本文讲述弗西特机长用一架瑞士小飞机经营空中出租车的故事。开篇用现在完成时（has bought、has begun）交代新业务，中间用一般过去时（flew、landed、wanted、did not take）追述一次次具体飞行：送医生进威尔士山区、降落在公寓楼顶与废弃停车场。结尾以 has just refused 回到现在，用 because the trip was too dangerous 点明拒绝理由。
lead.tips: 诀窍：见 since then、just 想到现在完成时，见 once、on another occasion 想到一般过去时；另外 a most + 形容词 中的 most 等于 very，并非最高级。

exercises.q: 课文标题里的 taxi 为什么要加引号？补全：Because it is not a real taxi but ______.
exercises.a: a small Swiss aeroplane called a 'Pilatus Porter'

exercises.q: 用过去分词作定语翻译：一片耕过的田；一个废弃的停车场。
exercises.a: a ploughed field; a deserted car park
exercises.note: 单个过去分词作定语常前置。

exercises.q: 选词填空：The doctor flew to a ______ village in the Welsh mountains.（lonely / alone）
exercises.note: lonely 可修饰地点，表“偏僻的”。

exercises.q: 用 refuse 或 deny 的正确形式填空：The secretary ______ that she has stolen the letter.
exercises.note: 否认用 deny，拒绝用 refuse。

exercises.q: bring / take / fetch 选词填空：Please ______ me a glass of water from the kitchen.
exercises.note: fetch 双程，bring 带来，take 拿走。

exercises.q: 改写句子：The trip was very dangerous, so he did not go. → The trip was ______ dangerous for him ______ go.
时态填空：Since then, Captain Fawcett ______ (fly) passengers to many unusual places. Once he ______ (land) on the roof of a block of flats.
exercises.note: since then 用完成时，once 用过去时。

quiz.q: 弗西特机长买下的那辆“出租汽车”实际上是什么？
options: A Swiss train running in the mountains
A red London double-decker bus
A small Swiss aeroplane called a 'Pilatus Porter'
A large ship that carries seven cars
quiz.note: 课文第 2 句即给出名称。

quiz.q: 关于这架飞机，最令人惊奇的一点是什么？
options: It can carry seventy passengers
It can fly without a pilot
It is painted bright red
It can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a ploughed field
quiz.note: The most surprising thing 后接表语从句。

quiz.q: 弗西特机长的第一位乘客是谁，飞往何处？
options: A doctor who flew from Birmingham to a lonely village in the Welsh mountains
A businessman who wanted to fly to Rockall
A farmer who worked in a ploughed field
An engineer from a Swiss factory
quiz.note: first passenger 后由 who 引导定语从句。

quiz.q: 有一次，弗西特机长把飞机降落在了哪里？
options: On a busy street in Birmingham
On the roof of a block of flats
Inside a Welsh mountain
On the top of a Swiss hotel
quiz.note: a block of flats 意为“一栋公寓楼”。

quiz.q: 那位商人想飞去的地方是哪里？
options: Rockall, a lonely island in the Atlantic Ocean
Birmingham, a big city in England
A deserted car park in Wales
A ploughed field near the village
quiz.note: Rockall 是大西洋中的孤岛。

quiz.q: 弗西特机长为什么没有带那位商人去？
options: The businessman had no money with him
His plane was already full of passengers
The trip was too dangerous
The island had no place to land at all
quiz.note: because 引导原因状语从句。
